**Notes:**
1. **2.8 s:** The label "15-year: $189,069" sits over the middle stack, and its tick points there too. But the 15-year is the short stack on the right, so the two closest labels read as one muddle. Fix: put each label straight above its own stack, at the same height and colour, with the leader lines going down.
2. **8.5 s:** The gold "difference" is a wide, flat slab on the middle stack. Then at 14 s it appears beside the house as a tall, narrow tower, so viewers won't see they're the same money. Fix: build the difference as the same tower shape, then fly it from the stack to the house in one continuous move.
3. **9–20 s:** The shot stays wide and almost static for 11 s, through "15-year plus a fallback" and "has a price". The "plus" is never shown. Fix: stand the 15-year stack beside the house and drop the gold tower on top of it at "plus" (15.9 s) so the two add up to the 30-year-paid-in-15. Only the outline flash at "price" lands.
4. **25.5 s:** At "October eighth unusual?", unlabelled grey slabs fade in (S10 pre-roll) and look like clutter. The two white pillars on the right are also never explained. Fix: show a single calendar-week tile under the house at 24.8 s, and remove or label the pillars.

**S10 scores:** Emotion/story 3 · Sound-off 3 · Pacing 3 · Composition 2

**Notes:**
1. **4.4 s:** The "flat" assumed-rate line recedes at a slant, so it reads as a trend, not a constant. It's also never seen next to the real lines. Fix: square the camera to the line, and keep it ghosted at the left while the wiggling lines draw in on the right (from 13.3 s).
2. **13.1 s:** The "30-year paid in 15" text spills past its card's border. The two cards also float with nothing linking them to anything. Fix: widen the card, and attach each card to its own survey line by colour.
3. **21.9 s:** The grid fills in on top of the rate lines, so both turn to grey mush. The two lines are low-contrast and unlabelled. Fix: drop the lines to a band under the grid, colour-match them to the cards, and fill the grid left to right in time with the lines.
4. **39.4 s:** Tessa's cell is a tiny white sliver, and it lights about 4 s after "Tessa's week" (33.2 s). "ILLUSTRATIVE" appears three times on screen, and Tessa's group is jammed against the left edge. Fix: light the cell gold to match her stack at 33.2 s, push in on it, and keep one ILLUSTRATIVE badge. Also, "how it was built is on screen" (29.7 s) has no method shown at all; add a one-line formula card there.
